title: Có
summary: Use Có when you mean yes, available, or there is, then use the notes below to keep the answer clear.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Có is the yes you hear when the question is about whether something exists, is available, or is possible in the moment. It answers questions like whether there is bottled water, a table, a room, a bathroom, a charger, or a SIM card. Use Dạ before it when you want the answer to sound softer.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Có when the simple answer is yes and the question is about availability, presence, or permission.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The same word can mean yes, have, or there is, depending on the question.

breakdown.english: yes / have / there is; available in this moment

sections.title: Answer contrast
sections.body: These short answers are close, but each one solves a different listening problem.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it after yes/no questions at counters, cafes, shops, hotels, transport desks, and attractions. It is especially useful when someone asks whether you have a booking, whether an item is available, or whether a service is possible.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Dạ có is a warmer full answer for many service moments. Có alone is fine when the moment is fast and the person only needs the answer.
